rules.activity: operate or access an ALPR system
rules.actor: Any person, including a public agency
rules.duty: Definitional scope for Title 1.81.23: an 'ALPR system' is a searchable computerized database resulting from one or more mobile or fixed cameras combined with algorithms that convert plate images to computer-readable data; an 'ALPR operator' operates such a system; an 'ALPR end-user' accesses or uses one; 'ALPR information' is data collected through an ALPR system; 'public agency' means the state or any city, county, or agency or political subdivision of the state, including a law enforcement agency. Out-of-state and federal agencies are not 'public agencies' under subdivision (f).
exceptions: Transportation agencies subject to Sts. & Hy. Code § 31490 are not ALPR operators or end-users.

End-user excludes persons subject to 15 U.S.C. §§ 6801-6809 and implementing state or federal statutes or regulations, if subject to state or federal regulatory compliance oversight for those sections; it also excludes a person other than a law enforcement agency to whom information may be disclosed as a permissible use under 18 U.S.C. § 2721. Eligibility, not actual receipt, is the latter predicate. Federal cross-reference eligibility remains unresolved and requires qualified human legal review.
rules.remedy: Definitions only; remedies attach through Civ. Code § 1798.90.54.

rules.duty: Maintain reasonable security procedures and practices, including operational, administrative, technical, and physical safeguards, to protect ALPR information from unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification, or disclosure.
rules.remedy: Civil action by a harmed individual against a person who knowingly caused the harm (Civ. Code § 1798.90.54).

sources.title: Civ. Code § 1798.90.51 (Added by Stats. 2015, ch. 532, § 3 (SB 34), effective 2016-01-01)

rules.duty: An operator must implement a privacy and usage policy respecting privacy and civil liberties across collection, use, maintenance, sharing and dissemination. Make it publicly available in writing and conspicuous online if the operator has a website. Minimum contents: (A) authorized system-use and collection purposes; (B) job titles or designations of employees and independent contractors authorized to use or access the system or collect ALPR information, and training requirements; (C) security and privacy-law monitoring; (D) sale, sharing and transfer purposes, processes and restrictions; (E) title of the ALPR-system custodian or owner responsible for implementing this section; (F) reasonable accuracy and error-correction measures; (G) retention length and the process for determining if and when to destroy retained information.
rules.remedy: Civil action by a harmed individual against a person who knowingly caused the harm (Civ. Code § 1798.90.54).

rules.activity: access or use an ALPR system
rules.duty: An end-user must maintain reasonable operational, administrative, technical and physical security safeguards against unauthorized access, destruction, use, modification or disclosure. Implement a privacy and usage policy respecting privacy and civil liberties in access, use, sharing and dissemination; make it publicly available in writing and conspicuous online if a website exists. Minimum contents: (A) authorized access and use purposes; (B) job titles or designations of employees and independent contractors authorized to access and use ALPR information, with training requirements; (C) security and privacy-law monitoring and a periodic system-audit process; (D) sale, sharing and transfer purposes, processes and restrictions; (E) title of the information custodian or owner responsible for implementing this section; (F) reasonable accuracy and error-correction measures; (G) retention length and the process for determining if and when to destroy retained information.
exceptions: Persons excluded from the end-user definition by Civ. Code § 1798.90.5(a).
rules.remedy: Civil action by a harmed individual against a person who knowingly caused the harm (Civ. Code § 1798.90.54).
